title: The Assyrian's March Against Jerusalem and God's Deliverance
description: The Lord comforts His people in Zion and promises that the yoke of the Assyrian will be lifted from their shoulders, just as He once struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb and brought the people out of Egypt. The prophet describes the enemy's march through the cities of Judah—Aiath, Migron, Michmash, Geba, Ramah, Gibeah of Saul, Gallim, Laishah, Anathoth, Madmenah, and Gebim—all the way to Nob, where he raises his hand against the mountain of the daughter of Zion. But the Lord Himself will cut down the proud branches with an axe, and Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
